messages:
alice: Hey team — I'm scheduled to press at 22:30 UTC but my MFA token on my phone is flaky. Can someone swap with me for the late-window prod press? Release v2.7.3 is pinned to commit d1f2e3. If no one can, we may need to hold the window. @dana FYI.
ben: I can take it if we confirm canary + rollback plan. I have deploy rights but need JIT approval to get the press-prod role.
carol: I don't have press-prod — only staging. @release-manager can we grant a short-lived delegate?
release-manager: Deploy-bot flow requires 2 approvers + MFA verification. You can request: `/grant_request temp-press ben 45m` and we'll approve.
dana: I'm +1 to approve. Ben — can you confirm you have a registered MFA device (yubikey or authenticator)? If not, we can consider a breakglass but need an audit note.
ben: I have a yubikey registered but phone battery is low. Sending `/grant_request temp-press ben 45m` now.
deploy-bot: Received grant request from ben. Preconditions: approver_count=2, mfa_present=true, role=press-prod. Audit ticket created: INC-4821. Approvers required: dana, carol.
carol: Approving now. Confirmed ben's yubikey registration via IAM. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Approval recorded (carol). Approvals=1/2.
release-manager: @dana please approve to reach 2/2 so the role can be issued.
dana: Approved. Granting temp-press to ben for 45m. Ben will receive an SSO prompt.
deploy-bot: temp-press role assigned to ben until 3412349980. Audit log: https://redwood.internal/audit/INC-4821
ben: I see the SSO prompt, MFA via yubikey succeeded. Quick ops notes: v2.7.3 pinned -> d1f2e3; canary at 10% for 15m; rollback command: `rctl rollback --to d1f2e2`.
alice: Thanks so much — I'll standby in case rollback is needed.
carol: Release notes: https://docs.redwood/release/v2.7.3-notes. During the canary verify latency, error-rate, and model output diffs on the eval suite.
dana: Ops checklist: don't change model_variant or routing_policy during the press. I'll watch the SLO dashboards and tracing.
ben: Pressing in 2m. Canary started. Logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/deploys/INC-4821. No immediate errors.
deploy-bot: Canary at 10% -> healthy (4/4 probes). Auto-promote scheduled in 15m if no regression.
ben: Promoting to 50% now, then to 100%.
deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated. Observed token throughput ~2x expected for this model.
ben: Rollout complete. Post-deploy smoke all green. Revoking temp role.
deploy-bot: temp-press role for ben revoked. Audit INC-4821 closed.
dana: Thanks everyone. Filing a quick retro about the MFA flake — alice, can you add a short note about backup keys for late windows?
alice: Will do. TL;DR: ensure a backup yubikey on call sheet for late windows. :memo:
carol: Noted. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
